title: Operation Prato as an official armed forces operation

tellings.quote: The operation took place. It was an official operation led by the armed forces to monitor these phenomena in the state of PA.

plain: In 1977, Brazil's armed forces ran an official operation, called Operation Prato, to watch strange phenomena in the sky over the state of Pará in northern Brazil. Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, confirms it: "The operation took place. It was an official operation led by the armed forces." Coming from him, it means the Brazilian state itself treated the sightings as real enough to investigate.
